_comment: DKT (Desikan-Killiany-Tourville) cortical parcels -> /regions human region keys (lobes).
Hand-curated, following the usual FreeSurfer lobe grouping (Klein & Tourville 2012):
paracentral goes with frontal (it is mostly BA4/6 on the medial surface); the four
cingulate parcels form their own region because our datasets tag the anterior cingulate.
Parcels listed nowhere (the medial wall, 'unknown') are drawn grey and not clickable.
Each key must be a human region in web/lib/brain-regions.ts (checked by the tests), and
the lobe's UBERON id lives there. Used by data/regions/build_human_svg.py.
